name: SAHAPAT JUNDUM

contact.text: Chonburi, Thailand (open to relocating to Bangkok)

items.text: Performance marketer with real-estate experience running Meta and Google Ads to find home buyers, plus a degree in Interactive and Game Design. I write ads, build lead forms, screen buyers and follow up until they book a viewing. I also create listing descriptions, short videos, Virtual Tours and 3D work, using AI tools to work faster while keeping the brand consistent.

bullets.text: Completed mandatory national military service; fully discharged.
Planned and ran Meta ad campaigns for renovated homes, writing ads that answered Thai buyers’ concerns to bring in quality leads.
Set up Google search ads using the keywords local buyers search for, and tracked website visits and results in GA4.
Kept ad messages consistent across Meta and Google, so buyers always saw the same offer and a clear next step.
Created lead forms asking buyers about location, budget and timing, then sorted leads and followed up until they booked a viewing.
Looked after buyers from first message to viewing: answered questions, handled concerns, arranged viewings and gave basic loan advice.
Managed property listings and Virtual Tours (filming, editing, publishing) so buyers could view homes online.
Wrote Thai listing descriptions and short video scripts, using AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to work faster.

items.desc: Created 3D characters, props and environments (low- and high-poly), from modeling and texturing to adding them into Unity with the team.
Edited photos and videos and came up with content ideas, working on-site with the production team.
Shadowed the 9up Idea team on esports motion graphics and worked on-site at Predator League Thailand events.
Built the full brand system solo: mascot, LINE Rich Menu, content cards and a working storefront at khunmadam.com.
Python chatbot that explains Thai PEA/MEA tariffs, Ft and TOU rates in plain language and estimates the monthly bill.

items.org: Stock watchlist bot with AI commentary
items.desc: Python + Telegram bot tracking 28 stocks: entry zones computed in code, Thai commentary by Claude with a strict no-invented-numbers guard, morning briefs, news impact and a desktop dashboard.
